title: pediomelum pariense
intro: Pediomelum pariense, commonly known as Parry's legume or Parry's milkvetch, is a perennial legume plant native to the western United States and Canada. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, and its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pediomelum pariense include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its healing properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
